plates.vo_idea: Orbit hangs in the dark — a tiny orange figure against a star that looks almost ordinary
plates.prompt: SHOT: Orbit is ALREADY hanging in the dark at frame 1 — a readable tiny orange figure (about one-eighth of frame height), cream eyes with pupils visible. He does not enter, fly in, or slide from the left. He hangs and slowly turns in place, antenna ticking, one soft underside glow. Behind him a compact star looks almost ordinary: a distant white-blue point that STAYS the same size for the whole clip. Camera: gentle lateral drift with parallax only. HARD FORBIDDEN: flying in from frame left, any push-in/zoom that makes the star grow, left-third portrait against a huge sun. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, one continuous matte orange sphere Orbit, black visor, two cream eyes with dark pupils, single antenna, no legs, no flames, no HUD text, vacuum of space, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Then the numbers arrive. And ordinary dies.
plates.prompt: SHOT: camera starts behind Orbit (over-his-shoulder / back of the orange sphere and antenna in the lower foreground) looking at an almost-ordinary distant star. Orbit is already in frame — he does not fly in. He turns his head so one visor and cream eyes catch the light as the star's nature goes WRONG: colour sickens, space warps, ordinary dies. Camera crane-up slowly, distance to the star stays constant — the star does NOT grow. HARD FORBIDDEN: left-edge fly-in, small-to-huge star zoom, repeating a side-by-side medium portrait. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, one orange sphere Orbit, cream eyes with pupils, one underside glow, no flames, no HUD, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.
